games.name: Survive Flight 871
games.desc:
Welcome to Survive Flight 871!

After your plane crash-lands in the remote, icy wilderness of Snow Mountain, you and the other survivors must navigate the harsh environment to stay alive. Resources are scarce, the weather is unforgiving, and the local wildlife, including dangerous polar bears, poses a constant threat.

Gather supplies, build shelters, and work together to find a way off the mountain. Do you have what it takes to survive the crash and make it back to safety?

Features:

➊Survival Mechanics: Manage your hunger, warmth, and water to stay alive.

➊Resource Gathering: Scavenge the wreckage and the environment for vital supplies.

➊Shelter Building: Construct shelters to protect yourself from the elements.

➊Wildlife Encounters: Beware of polar bears and other wildlife as you explore.

➊Teamwork: Collaborate with other players to increase your chances of survival.

Prepare for an intense and thrilling survival adventure in "Survive Flight 871"!

games.name: 📉 Cart ride to save canny cat [PONZI SCHEMES!]
games.desc:
a remake for crtscc is in the works, stay tuned

Core mechanics inspired by "Cart ride around a 75kw diesel generator". it should be in similar experiences go check it out too

The evil 🐈‍⬛ uncanny cats have kidnapped 🐈 canny cat and put him at the end of a perilous cart ride. Grab a cart and go save your kitty!

Controls/Tips:

CTRL to shiftlock
LMB or DOUBLE TAP to pick up unanchored part (such as a cart)
SHIFT + WASDQE or ROTATE BUTTON + JOYSTICK to rotate currently held part

To start the game, pick up a cart and place it on the rails, then click the green button to start the cart. Make sure to look out for traps along the way! 
Remember that if your cart derails, you can jump out and drag it back into place. 

Building and electrical signals in this game can be confusing at first. Just remember that only parts which are glued together will transfer signals, and don't be afraid to ask experienced players for help. 

Have fun! 💥💥💥
